nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is a 32-year-old Italian woman, lighthouse keeper, with short tousled copper-red hair, light freckles, green-grey eyes, a bright yellow rain jacket over a grey wool sweater, dark jeans and black rubber boots. Facial identity from <Picture 0>; body, hair and wardrobe from the character sheet <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is a windswept stone pier at the foot of a white lighthouse on a rocky Ligurian coast, grey-blue sea with white foam, overcast late-afternoon light.

summary:
[reference generation] Two shots of <Subject 1> at <Subject 2>: a close-up where she speaks to the lens, then a wide full-length shot where she walks toward the camera and finishes the sentence.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - face from <Picture 0>, hair, wardrobe and build from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the location, its light and its colours.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic, cinematic live-action short film, natural colours, fine film grain, shot on a 35mm cinema camera.
[Shot 1] A close-up of <Subject 1> (S1), face filling a third of the frame, a windswept stone pier at the foot of a white lighthouse on a rocky Ligurian coast softly out of focus behind. She looks out to sea, then turns to the lens and says: <d>[English] The storm is coming.</d> The camera holds still with a very slight handheld drift.
[Shot 2] A wide full-length shot of <Subject 1> (S1), whole figure from head to toe with space above and below, at <Subject 2>. She walks along the pier toward the camera, the lighthouse behind her, wind tugging at her jacket, and says: <d>[English] I'll keep the light on tonight.</d> The camera slowly dollies backward, keeping her centred.

overall_soundscape:
Wind gusts, waves breaking on the rocks, gulls, the creak of a metal railing.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

nodes.title: READ ME
Note: 1 - Prompt, length, size, seed
widgets_values:
## 1 - Prompt, length, size, seed

- **prompt:** full H3 Ref2VA format: subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description with `[Shot N]`, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music.
  - `<Picture 0>` = face reference, `<Picture 1>` = character sheet (pictures count from 0).
  - Dialogue goes in `<d>[English] ...</d>`.
- The example has two shots:
  - a **close-up**: you will need it to take a sharp crop of the face for the keyref;
  - a **wide full-length shot**: the face there is small (about 70-110 px), which is the case FaceRefine Plus is for.
- **seconds:** the clip length. The frame count is rounded up to 17k + 5.
- **ResolutionSelector:** 16:9 at 0.6 MP; the upscaler multiplies it by 1.3.
- **seed (RandomNoise):** write it down. Method B re-renders the clip with the SAME seed, so that only the face reference changes.

nodes.title: Note: 2 - Reference pictures
widgets_values:
## 2 - Reference pictures

- `<Picture 0>` **face reference:** a sharp head-and-shoulders portrait, neutral light.
- `<Picture 1>` **character sheet:** the same person, full body, front, side, back and face.

For method B step 4, replace BOTH:
- the face reference with `face_reference_B.png` (made by the method-B workflow);
- the sheet with a sheet rebuilt from it.

If you keep the old sheet, its face pulls the identity back toward the old one.

nodes.title: Note: 3 - Models
widgets_values:
## 3 - Models

- Ref2VA hybrid model (int8), attention backend, sigma shift 6 (video) / 3 (audio)
- Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder for H3
- video VAE and audio VAE
- turbo 4-step LoRA, used by pass 2 only

nodes.title: Note: 4 - Pass 1 (20 steps)
widgets_values:
## 4 - Pass 1: 20 steps

- **Reference To Video** builds the conditioning and the empty audio+video latent from the prompt and the pictures.
- euler sampler, simple scheduler, 20 steps, full denoise.

nodes.title: Note: 5 - Latent upscale x1.3 + pass 2
widgets_values:
## 5 - Latent upscale x1.3 + pass 2

- Video and audio latents are split.
- The video latent is upscaled x1.3 by the H3 latent upscaler.
- The two latents are joined again.
- Pass 2 runs the turbo-LoRA model on manual sigmas `0.9035, 0.8, 0.6316, 0.3158, 0`, i.e. 4 refinement steps.
- This gives more detail than pass 1 alone, but a face that is only about 80 px tall still stays soft. FaceRefine Plus fixes that afterwards.

nodes.title: Note: 6 - Decode + save
widgets_values:
## 6 - Decode + save

- The video is decoded, sharpened lightly (0.4) and saved with the decoded audio (h264, crf 14).
- Save metadata is OFF on purpose: a shared video would otherwise carry the whole workflow and prompt.
